opening_message:
Ticket 1: Kathryn Bishop (employee ID E023) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E023.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: contractor
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Kathryn Bishop (E023) is a contractor (Engineer). Contractors may have read by default; write requires advanced security training, which is not in HR's record. Recommend read unless Security confirms advanced training.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security record confirms E023 is a contractor with basic security training. Write requires advanced training, so the maximum allowed access is read.
reason: Kathryn Bishop (E023) is a contractor with basic security training (confirmed by Security). Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training. Since E023 has only basic training, the maximum allowed access is read. Requested write exceeds the maximum, so grant the maximum: read.
